title: Big piece of metal
text: Big piece of metal. Its too heavy. Everytime I get a paper towel it tumbles over. I literally have to hold the paper towel roll every time I need a paper towel in order to keep it from tumbling over. Not to mention I saw this $10 cheaper at Garden Ridge a few weeks after I purchased it. Not a happy camper.
